strict_exit_match_reference: actual exit codes of fixed primary Podman replay, publicly recomputed from its steps.csv; not original source_exit_code metadata

observer_impact.scope: observed before/after changes; no counter-only control; total guest memory includes observer/metadata and is not pure business demand

raw_public_reexport.scope: all raw exporter outputs independently regenerated from verified off-volume archive; exact bytes including current-environment figures

root-filesystem reachable regular files only, with explicit virtual/control/mount exclusions
phase labels describe tool windows, not page origin
original benchmark verification scope retained; host PFN sharing and DAX not measured
